ph_concl_claim.text: Hearthsalt lozenge use was associated with a higher dusk-spot risk in this cohort.

ph_hedge.text: The contrast possibly reflects vellum-mark imbalance rather than a lozenge effect.

ph_limitation.text: The observational comparison precludes causal inference.
